content:
Today’s macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 3 release includes two new wallpaper and screen saver options for your Mac.

Both new wallpaper/screen saver options are the first to fit the theme of the macOS 27 version name: Golden Gate. The two new options join the existing “27” wallpaper that was already available in the pre-release macOS version.

The new two macOS 27 wallpapers include:

  • Golden Gate Sunset
  • Golden Gate Night

Both include motion on the Lock Screen when unlocking your Mac or when set as your screen saver.

macOS 27 Golden Gate is currently available as a developer beta preview. A public beta preview for macOS 27 Golden Gate is coming later this month.

You can see our roundup of everything new in iOS 27 beta 3, macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 3, and more here.
